beats.text: Jesus told a story about a widow. She had lost her husband and had no one to protect her. Someone had wronged her, and she had no power, no money, no one important to make anyone listen.

beats.text: There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.
